title: Gold hat{U} attempt: frozen calibrated U vs independent leftover y
question: Does frozen calibrated U stay a probability when y is moved between two independent leftover connectomes (same e>0.25, count>=10)?

P.method: frozen experiment C isotonic map of locked U

y.C_a_C_b: two independent leftover connectomes of the same freeze (radial_4, count, QC-PASS, empty_nodes=0)
not: A5/A6 ANTs ensemble reused as leftover

split.if_P_is_frozen_C: no refit; all leftover sessions are test
split.held_out: the leftover list; never the A5/A6/A7/A8 six-session frequency

occupied_bin.rule: every equal-width bin with n>=20 on the leftover test pool is scored
occupied_bin.why: A8 required B9 and it was empty; requiring it again is the failed name, not this exam

win: ECE(calibrated U) is computed on leftover y AND every occupied bin (n>=20) has |mean_y - mean_P| <= 0.15. Then and only then the 78x78 number may be named hat{U}.
fail: any miss or list still empty. Keep calibrated U as a 1 mm probability. Do not name hat{U}. Do not name proxy-hat{U}.
forbidden: start ECE before LIST.json has >=2 paths
Gugger walk to fill the list
change band or cuts after seeing leftover ECE
revive A8 frequency as P unless a later lock writes a new win rule that does not need B9
